تستسقوا (form X)
# تَسْتَسْقُوا (tastasqū) /tas.tas.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# تُسْتَسْقَوْا (tustasqaw) /tus.tas.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
